Overview

A bit about me

I'm a tinkerer and a game fanatic. My interests have taken me all over the place, but I'm ultimately motivated by using technology to solve interesting, people-oriented problems.

Throughout my career thus far, this has manifested in building a data tracking tool for farmers, a dating app for friends to match their friends, and a social platform for watch enthusiasts. They're now preserved in a little digital museum of past projects.

Now, I've turned my attention to AI and how it interfaces with people. I joined Decagon AI to learn how to build and deploy production AI agents at scale.

However, like I said, I'm always tinkering. On the side, I am building better knowledge factories for agents. I often spend mornings reading, a penchant for which I’ve rediscovered thanks to my Grokbot’s daily recommendations for awesome pieces.

Outside of work is where I get to invest in being a huge game fanatic: board games, strategy games, party games, you name it. I'm tinkering with AI to build awesome custom-made games for my friends.

I was previously a PM at Schmidt Futures (fmr. Google CEO family office), an early stage VC at Armory Square Ventures, and a SWE at Paypal. I graduated a Merrill Presidential Scholar (top 1% of my college) from Cornell University with an honors degree in computer science. My thesis focused on using machine learning and satellite imagery to better model and map disease risk in vineyards.
